From: Riley Cho <riley@codeflow.dev>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in GitHub integration — quick call?

Hi team,

I signed up and poked around Redwood's docs this morning — nice work on the GitHub app screenshots. We're evaluating a few inference providers to add code search embeddings + a reranker for PR triage. A couple quick questions before a demo: do you support private repo access (enterprise/EGS) and can the GitHub App be installed org-wide? Also, we'll need to know what webhook events you require (PR opened, push, issue_comment, etc).

We're in PST (San Francisco). Would like a short 20–30 min screening call first — weekdays after 3pm PST are best for our engineering lead (Alex). Can we schedule something this week?

Thanks,
Riley

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in GitHub integration — quick call?

Hi Riley — Monica here (Solutions Engineering). Quick notes before the call so we can make best use of 20–30 minutes:

1) Private repo access: yes — our GitHub App supports org-wide installation and granular repo permissions. For enterprise server (GHES), we offer a connector but there are a couple extra steps (proxying webhook endpoints and a short firewall rule).

2) Webhook events: common set we ask for — push, pull_request, pull_request_review, pull_request_review_comment, issue_comment. We can work with a restricted subset for indexing only PRs and pushes.

3) Data flow & security: Redwood never persists raw source-only tokens; we recommend using a bot/service account with read-only repo access for indexing and an install token for webhook delivery. We can provide a SOC2-audit-friendly checklist.

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist and a template text file you can paste repo names into — if you attach that, we can pre-size the demo (batching/quant settings) and bring relevant benchmark numbers.

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)
Attachment: codeflow-repos-list.txt (TXT, 1 KB)

If any of these slots work for you, I can take the technical minutes and demo. For the shorter flow: 20 min screening + 20 min technical with me is our usual pattern.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
[Teams/Zoom: monica.redwood]
